entries.title: The Crust
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC Steam Early Access build

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC Early Access presentation.

primary.why: The Crust is a Windows PC lunar-base automation and colony/base-building game from VEOM Studio and Crytivo. Steam still marks it as Early Access as of this pass, with a listed July 15, 2026 planned exit, and the Artemis Edition bundle adds soundtrack/supporter content rather than a gameplay-complete edition split. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the only sourced route, but the archive recommendation is provisional until 1.0.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build only if an in-development capture is acceptable; otherwise wait for the planned 1.0 release and revalidate.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game: revalidate after the planned 1.0 exit. Artemis Edition bundles soundtrack/supporter content rather than a gameplay-remaster route.
